page_0.title: Automation & AI Testing Courses by Gianni Bruno | WebDriver University
page_0.summary:
- Main purpose: a hub/catalog for Automation & AI testing courses and interactive demo pages (practice modules) hosted by WebDriver University.
- Main user flows: browse/select course or demo tiles via navigation/toggle, open interactive modules (e.g., BUTTON CLICKS, TO DO LIST, IFRAME, FILE UPLOAD, DATEPICKER), use CONTACT US form, and use LOGIN PORTAL.
- Key interactive targets: demo pages with IDs (#button-clicks, #to-do-list, #iframe, #file-upload, #ajax-loader, #datepicker, #hidden-elements, #popup-alerts, #dropdown-checkboxes-radiobuttons, etc.).
- Typical actions: click/toggle nav items, submit login/contact forms, upload files, pick dates, interact with alerts/iframes, wait for AJAX, scroll and perform action sequences.
- Important edge cases: asynchronous loads and timing (AJAX loader, delayed elements), iframe cross-origin and focus/selector scope, hidden/disabled elements and reveal behaviors, file upload size/type errors, datepicker bounds/formatting, modal/alert interrupting flows, stale element references after DOM updates.
- Other considerations: navigation toggle responsiveness, stateful flows (session/login persistence), accessibility and keyboard interactions for interactive widgets.

coverage_summary: The test cases cover navigation to all course links available on page_0. Each test validates that clicking on a course link leads to the respective course page. Notable gaps include the absence of tests for verifying the content of the destination pages or handling invalid scenarios, such as broken links or missing pages.
